specification.function: whether every named piece sits in its home position with each sticker in its own home slot (identity, slot and orientation)
specification.inputs: pieces: piece IDs; home_slots: their home slots, model data the host names with the pieces

parameters.none: the entry has no parameter beyond its inputs

budget.none: the entry sets no budget of its own: a run is bounded by the run limits of the job that runs it (KN7.7)

menu.none: 600-cell-Full has no menu: its 1,200 generators are the model's

specification.domain: every nonempty list of pieces at any revision

tie_rule.none: the answer is one value: the entry ranks nothing and chooses among nothing

empty_answer.none: the answer is a Bool; an empty list of pieces answers false, so empty candidates never pass (CT-LB2-04)

specification.negative_scope: false means at least one named piece is away from home or wrongly oriented, or the home slots named are not the pieces'; it says nothing about pieces not named.

outside_scope.none: the definition of solved covers every revision: the entry compares positions and labels exactly

justification.statement: in the solved state every slot holds its own label
justification.text: A piece is complete when its positions row puts each of its stickers in its home slot and the labels at its home slots are its own; in the solved state every slot holds its own label.

evidence.none: a definition: the solved state is the identity labelling

reason.idea: A piece is done when each of its stickers sits in its own home slot; in the solved puzzle that holds for every piece.

failure.outcome: weaker conclusion: in a scrambled state the answer depends on the named piece and can be false

by_hand.not_meant: true for the named pieces says nothing about the other pieces, and the entry never names a piece to work on.
